comment: Per-resort corrections applied by pipeline/normalize_osm.py (ADR-036). Each entry names one OSM element, the reason, what OSM holds today (`expect`, checked on every build: if OSM changes, the build stops so a fix made in OSM is never silently overwritten) and the change: `set` (name, or null to hide it; difficulty; park; out_of_bounds) or `hide: true`. Plain factual errors should also be fixed in OSM itself.
